The introduction of E20 petrol in India followed extensive testing and validation by automobile manufacturers and industry experts. I have been a regular customer at this petrol pump, but my recent experiences have been extremely disappointing. Due to the long queues for two-wheelers, cars are frequently forced to exit from the rear side. Unfortunately, the space there is very limited, making it difficult to maneuver a car safely.

The poles and chains placed around the area are kept too close together and are often unstable. They frequently tilt or fall against vehicles, causing unnecessary scratches and damage. On top of that, the rear exit is often blocked by bikes and other vehicles, making the situation even worse. Many times, I have had to step out of my car myself just to move poles and barricades so I could exit.

Adding to the frustration, petrol is often unavailable, resulting in long and unnecessary waiting times without any clear communication.

What’s most disappointing is the lack of support from the staff. Even after repeatedly pointing out these issues, they insist that cars leave through the rear exit and offer no assistance.

Due to these ongoing problems and the poor handling of customer concerns, I have decided not to visit this petrol pump again. I would strongly advise anyone driving a petrol car to be cautious before choosing this location.

🚨 Beware of Cheating at this Petrol Pump! 🚨

I had a very bad experience here with DEF fluid filling. First of all, when I asked one person if DEF was available, he confidently said “No”. Then another person came and said “Yes” – clearly trying to confuse customers.

I purchased 10 liters DEF for ₹850. My car’s DEF tank capacity is 20 liters, and it was already at 54% (Approximately 10 litres). So, after adding 10 liters, it should have reached 100% full.

But after they “filled” it, the meter showed only 71%. That means they filled just 4 liters instead of 10 liters. When I questioned them, they gave silly excuses like “The remaining fluid in the can won’t come out”. They also did not even use a proper funnel – just pushed a pipe inside carelessly.

When I checked the can, more than 5 liters were still left inside, but the staff shamelessly claimed it was “finished”. I’ve also added pictures of Car DEF level and remaining volume of DEF in Can. This is nothing but open cheating and fraud with customers.

1)  They charge for 10 liters but fill less.
2)  Staff keep confusing answers to trap customers.
3)  No proper equipment or honesty in service.

⚠️ My advice: Avoid this petrol pump at all costs. They are looting people in the name of DEF fluid. Please always come out of your vehicle and check carefully while refueling here. This pump cannot be trusted.
